name: Potions heal fully as an action
author: Alexandria
summary: Drinking a healing potion with your action heals the maximum; a bonus action rolls as usual.

rules.text: When you drink a healing potion **as an action**, it heals its **maximum** (a potion of healing heals 10). Drinking it as a **bonus action** rolls the dice as normal. Pairs well with Potions as a bonus action.

assistant.gm: Healing potions drunk with an action heal their maximum (potion of healing: 10). As a bonus action they roll normally.
assistant.player: At this table drinking a healing potion with your action heals its maximum (10 for a potion of healing); as a bonus action you roll.
